Public fixture provenance

JavaScript and template excerpts in these fixtures retain their original public-source bytes, source bundle hashes and slice offsets. Local capture paths are omitted.

Private Run, response, object and event identifiers are not required to test option dependencies. The board/catalog fixtures retain only public type/option mappings and the structural reset observation used by their tests. Historical availability data is reduced to aggregate counts, without account state or quoted amounts. The production-cache snapshot is omitted; synthetic tests cover its selection and page boundaries.

The 150-row unavailable-price response and the quantity-spanning proof-fee table contain explicitly synthetic amounts. They test parser shape, availability rejection and dynamic fee presentation. They are not captured supplier prices, source-cost evidence or reusable quotes. Private historical receipts remain outside the repository.
